description: Build the LMS package for a licence and language and return a download link valid 7 days. The customer uploads the ZIP unchanged into their LMS (SCORM Cloud, Moodle, SuccessFactors …). format: scorm12 (default), scorm2004 (4th edition) or cmi5. mode dispatch (default): small wrapper loading our player (seats, lock and expiry stay under our control). mode offline: self-contained ZIP with videos, player, materials and knowledge test — only if the licence has offline_allowed; licensee, seats and end date are shown on the start page and in the manifest, but nothing is enforced any more. Superadmins only.

format.description: LMS standard of the package. Default scorm12

language.description: package language; default the licence's first language

offline_media.description: offline only: all videos (default) or only the main video (smaller); materials always

name: lms_package_build
